headline: The gravel yard goes online
lede: Two browsers, one shift: GravelYard got lobby seats — a friend on any phone joins by 4-letter code and drives the dump truck while you dig, with the sims hash-checked against each other every half second.

notes.text: GRAVEL YARD ONLINE (#1672): ?net=host prints a room code on the marquee, the second browser joins and gets the truck. Lockstep pads (sample once, 8 ticks ahead) mean both screens run the identical shift; desync or a walkaway freezes the yard with an honest toast instead of a silent lie.

A lane collision found a real bug on another PR: a union-rebase left a duplicated YAML key in ci.yml, so the CI workflow silently never started and a merge loop spun blind for an hour. Fixed on #1656, which shipped; a live mutation caught in MagicCarpet's pushed head is flagged on #1668 with the exact fix line.

gravelcheck grew twin-box proof gates: two in-memory boxes over the real engine must stay hash-equal, stall together when pads are lost, and be caught red-handed when streams diverge. Mutant-proven: flip one bit in the wire mask and it goes red.
